## Quick start

[Download the Android APK](https://github.com/AieXile/AnimeTrack/releases/latest) and expand **Assets**. Your device must run **Android 8.0 (API 26) or later**.

| Package | Suitable devices |
| --- | --- |
| `-v8a.apk` | Most newer Android phones and tablets |
| `-v7a.apk` | 32-bit ARM devices |
| `-universal.apk` | Choose this if you are not sure of your device's architecture |

Open the APK and follow the system prompts to install. Users who already have the official GitHub release installed can upgrade over it directly.

- **Start tracking from the first title.** Tap the "+" button on the home screen, search for the anime title, choose a watch status, and save. You can then update the episode count and rating on the detail page.
- **Bring in your existing tracking records.** You can import from Bangumi or Bilibili. Under **Settings → Data management**, you can import Markdown or restore a WebDAV backup. For the differences between these methods, see [Sync and backup](#同步与备份).
- **Connect your own videos.** Go to **Settings → Video playback** to authorize a local folder, configure a WebDAV media directory, or paste a compatible video URL. For available sources and progress-linking rules, see [Video playback](#视频播放).

## Tracking and collections

- **Build your anime library from search.** Look up titles via Bangumi or TMDB and bring in the cover, episode count, and air dates. Manual addition is supported, and you can re-match missing information on the detail page. When adding multiple titles, you can switch keywords or sources to keep selecting, then save once at the end.
- **Remember which episode you are on.** Mark an anime as "Want to watch," "Watching," or "Watched," and record the episode count, rating, and notes. The home screen supports list and grid views, with search, sorting, and pinning. After finishing a series, review your watch history by month in the timeline.
- **Browse a series together.** Bangumi's prequel and sequel relationships and title season numbers are used to identify series, stacking related titles into one card. Swipe to switch between seasons and see progress for the current season directly.
- **Group your favorites.** In Collections, create a collection, pick a cover for it, and drag to reorder collections or the titles inside them. Pinch to collapse an open collection. Deleting a collection keeps its titles in **All favorites**.
- **See which day each show updates.** The dashboard lists the ongoing series you have added by day of the week; tap a poster to open its details. Today's airings, watching progress, and tracking statistics can also be added to your phone's home screen.

## Video playback

The built-in player has been officially available since **v1.0.0**. Enable the playback button on the detail page under **Settings → Features**, and you can pick episodes from an anime's detail page. Linked episodes can be resumed directly.

[English] [中文] --- ## 📖 Introduction **dbVisitor** is a **unified data access foundation** built on the JDBC standard, dedicated to realizing the vision of **“One APIs Access Any DataBase”**. Through its unique **dual-layer adapter architecture**, it breaks the programming barrier between RDBMS and NoSQL, allowing developers to seamlessly operate MySQL, MongoDB, Elasticsearch, and other databases using **the same set of standard APIs**. dbVisitor does not advocate inventing new syntax to hide differences. # ComfyUI-GPU-Tuning

Comprehensive measurement and tuning of ComfyUI's model inference implementations: int8 linear, attention, VAE, text encoder, and single-token decoding. **Does not modify ComfyUI source code**; everything is installed as runtime wrappers. `COMFY_GPU_TUNE=off` disables all of it. Which optimizations are enabled is determined by measured data; GPUs that have not been measured keep the generic path.

## Measured results (MI50 32 GB):

| Model | Parameters | Node disabled | Node enabled |
|---|---|---|---|
| Qwen-Image 2.1 | 1024²              | 19.73 s/it | 3.55 s/it |
| Qwen3.5-9B     | 4096 context       | 1.27 it/s  | 37 it/s   |
| SDXL           | 1024² batch_size 4 | 4.85 s/it  | 3.49 s/it |

## Installation

1. Clone the repository into the ComfyUI custom nodes directory
```bash
git clone https://github.com/LaoBro/ComfyUI-GPU-Tuning custom_nodes/ComfyUI-GPU-Tuning
```
2. See [docs/PORTING.md](https://github.com/LaoBro/ComfyUI-GPU-Tuning/blob/HEAD/docs/PORTING.md) for measurement and tuning; this can be handed off to an agent to complete automatically

## Two nodes

| Node | Location | Purpose |
|---|---|---|
| **GPU Tuning Model Settings** | Model chain (between loader and sampler) | Attention mode, layout and fp16 strategy, int8 tile, QKV, VAE, GEMV, profiler, etc. |
| **GPU Tuning CLIP Settings** | CLIP chain (loader → encode) | Text encoder int8, TE GEMV, 4-bit w4a8, text generation patch group |

Changes to the settings nodes take effect on the next execution; no restart is needed. For the full table of switches and environment variables, see [docs/CONFIG.md](https://github.com/LaoBro/ComfyUI-GPU-Tuning/blob/HEAD/docs/CONFIG.md).

SpaceRelay/dsh-subagent-control.body:
# dsh-subagent-control

**Lets any agent, including team members, list, follow up with, and stop the subagents it has spawned.**

`list_subagents` · `send_subagent_message` · `interrupt_subagent`

> [English](https://github.com/SpaceRelay/dsh-subagent-control/blob/HEAD/README.en.md) | 中文

This repository contains five packages, and each one must be installed separately. The one you are looking at is the first: a subagent management tool for agents. The other four are listed under 「相关插件」(Related Plugins) below.

In DSH, an agent can hand part of its work to another agent. The agent that was handed the work is called a 「子代理」(subagent). This plugin lets the dispatching agent see its subagents, send them additional messages, and stop them.

## When it's useful

- You dispatched several subagents to work in parallel and want to know which are still running and how far they have got
- You want to add a message to a subagent that is currently working
- You want to stop one that has gone off track
- A subagent dispatched by a team member should also be controllable from above

## Three tools

| Tool | What it does | Parameters |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `list_subagents` | Lists the subagents you dispatched | `scope`: `children` (default, direct subagents) / `descendants` (entire subtree); `include_teammates`: default `true` |
| `send_subagent_message` | Sends a follow-up message to one direct subagent | `subagent_id`, `message` |
| `interrupt_subagent` | Stops a subagent's current turn | `subagent_id` |

After installation, the agent calls `list_subagents` once and gets one line per subagent:

```
3b0f9c1e  running   "review the patch"  depth=1
7d2a44b0  inactive  "check the tests"   depth=2
```

From left to right: the id, the current status, the task it is working on in quotes, and the depth. `depth=1` is a subagent you dispatched directly; `depth=2` is one that it dispatched further. `running` means it is actively working. `inactive` only means no turn is executing at this moment. It does not mean the subagent is gone; sending it a message will wake it.

Messaging and interrupting are simpler. `send_subagent_message` takes an id and a message, and returns a message id. `interrupt_subagent` takes only an id, and returns whether the request was accepted.

chinjiaqing/jc-daily-report.body:
# ⚽ Football Signal Radar · Daily Signal Report

> **Set emotion aside and watch only the signals.**
> Cross-validation of odds movements across three channels. No bets on low odds; no bets when the signal is unclear. Automatic before matches, automatic settlement after.

## 🚀 Online Site

- **[https://chinjiaqing.github.io/jc-daily-report/](https://chinjiaqing.github.io/jc-daily-report/)**
- Updated automatically every hour, with historical dates archived for review at any time
- Covers 500 to 1300+ matches per day (full Jingcai and Asian handicap coverage), automatically flagging signals and bets

---

## The Detours We Bypassed

We tried **models**: piled up parameters by the dozen. Looking back, the model just recited prices the market had already set. No matter how many parameters, it could not produce anything new.

We tried **studying the operators**: guessing at the bookmakers' tactics over and over, and the more we guessed, the more it looked like paranoia. In the end it became clear that guessing the bookmaker is pointless; watch the price instead.

We also tried **AI predictions**: injuries, motivation, form. Every point sounded convincing, and every one had long been priced into the odds. However lively it sounded, the handicap did not agree.

With the detours behind us, one plain truth remains:

> **Where the money goes, the handicap speaks.**
> But people watching the lines get carried away easily: chasing favorites, fearing underdogs, shaky hands at the last minute. It is easy to see that emotion is what's trading.

So we hand both "watching" and "buying" to the machine, and people keep just one thing: **discipline**.

## Three Informants, One Referee

**European odds (1X2)** track market-wide odds movements: who has been collectively abandoned, who is quietly defending, and whether the draw line has been given up. This is the informant closest to the action.

**Asian handicap** tracks lines and water levels: sudden pivots right before kickoff, and big money snapping up the upper side. The money is real cash slammed in, more honest than anything said out loud.

**Over/under** tracks the total-goals line: when a goal-scoring hotbed appears, the number of goals in the match has often already been decided.

Each informant has its own news. When the news lines up, the referee dares to make the call. **Matches where they disagree (European odds and Asian handicap contradicting each other) are left alone entirely.** When the informants are arguing among themselves, there is no reason to bet.

## Discipline Matters More Than Vision

Once the direction is set, everything else is discipline:

- **No bets on low odds:** single-selection odds below 1.5, or double-selection odds below 1.3 after discounting. No matter how good the signal, it isn't bought. At odds that low, even a win earns little.
- **No bets without a clear signal:** no signal, conflicting signals, or a vague direction all mean waiting. Missing a bet loses no money; betting wrong does.
- **Quality determines stake size:** the stronger the signal, the larger the stake (1/2/4 units). No all-in gambling.
- **Automatic betting 15 minutes before kickoff, automatic settlement when results come in:** no shaky hands at the last minute, and no urge to raise stakes after a win or to chase losses.

---

## ⚠️ Disclaimer

This project is for data research only and does not constitute any purchase advice. Buy lottery tickets only at licensed physical retail outlets. Anyone under 18 may not participate.

# oil-cover

Generates covers in three aspect ratios based on real video content, with frame selection analysis, title design, and optional creator avatar compositing.

Direction: **real screen evidence + Apple-like product visuals + clear titles + clean person-free composition**. The cover is generated as one complete image in a single pass, not assembled locally by overlaying text.

> Author: oil 欧呦（[@oil-oil](https://github.com/oil-oil)）

## Features

- **Fast video frame selection**: Local multi-threaded scanning and scoring filters out high-definition candidate frames, then a multimodal model selects by semantics. The entire video is not uploaded.
- **Complete visual spec**: `references/cover-rules.md` covers composition, background layers, font and titles, accents, automatic quality checks, and prompt skeletons.
- **Three aspect ratios and on-demand parallel subsets**: By default, generates Xiaohongshu `3:4` portrait, general/Bilibili homepage main cover `4:3` landscape, and `16:9` landscape in parallel. Also supports `--aspect both` (`3:4` + `4:3`), a single aspect ratio, or comma-separated combinations (e.g. `3x4,4x3`). Within each image generation thread, optional avatar compositing completes automatically in a streaming fashion, and progress is written to a state file (`.oil-cover/generation_state.json` or `--cover-state-file`).
- **Automatic product logo matching**: Built-in logos for common AI products including Claude / Codex / Cursor / Gemini / GitHub.

Specified cover titles are locked into the analysis and every aspect ratio's prompt. When a title or theme is present, logo matching no longer falls back to secondary brands in the subtitles. When no trustworthy asset is available, recognition is established using the product name and real interface. For newly added reference assets, see the [asset list](https://github.com/oil-oil/oil-cover/blob/HEAD/references/product-assets.md).

## Two Execution Modes

| | Script mode (default) | Agent autonomous execution |
| --- | --- | --- |
| How to run | Run `scripts/generate_oil_cover.py` | The executing agent reads the SOP and completes the work end to end |
| Frame selection / analysis | ZenMux `google/gemini-3.8-flash` | The agent's own multimodal vision |
| Image generation | ZenMux `gpt-image-2.5-flare` | The agent's built-in image generation tool (image-to-image) |
| Dependencies | Python + ffmpeg + ZenMux key | Only an agent with an image generation tool (e.g. Codex built-in `image_gen`) |
| Best for | High fidelity, reproducible | Zero external dependencies, zero keys |

oil-oil/oil-ppt.description: Create, edit, and inspect 16:9 HTML presentations, with page-by-page editing, offline presentation, and hybrid editable PPTX export.
oil-oil/oil-ppt.body:
The fifteen slides above come from four real presentations, using yellow, cobalt blue, moss green, and terracotta. They share the same design system, but the materials, density, and page structure change with the content.

Each slide is an independent HTML source file that can be opened on its own. The agent creates or modifies only one page at a time. oil-ppt provides mature components, global design tokens, real browser checks, and the final single-file build. In the end, only one `演示文稿.html` is delivered.

| Agent responsibilities | oil-ppt responsibilities | Our responsibilities |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Understand the audience, organize the narrative, write HTML page by page, select materials and composition | Stage, scaling, design tokens, components, asset inlining, and browser checks | Confirm the creative direction and the formal preview |

The north star of oil-ppt is: low floor, high ceiling. Cost-effective models can start from mature HTML starters and components. Stronger models can directly modify the single-page DOM and local CSS, without being constrained by page fields.

oil-ppt breaks a large task into a local loop:

1. Create a brief from reference materials or Markdown.
2. Create a real HTML page.
3. Choose a starter, combine components, or fully customize.
4. Use a program to check this page's structure, assets, and browser results.
5. Return to the full-deck preview to adjust the order, split pages, merge pages, or delete pages.

Weaker models do not need to maintain the whole deck's page structure at once. Stronger models do not need to modify the rendering program for a new composition. Both follow the same progressive path: starter → combined components → modify local DOM/CSS → fully custom page.

```text
Topic or materials
  → Optional per-page outline: what each page does and what it shows
  → Agent writes HTML page by page
  → Single-page checks and whole-deck adjustments
  → Formal preview
  → We confirm the visuals
  → 演示文稿.html
```

The presentation scales proportionally to the browser's actual visible area, and works with window resizing and browser zoom. Default titles use a lighter font weight and open letter spacing, and pages keep only the text that helps explain the content.

The outline only lists what each page is meant to say and its main visuals, without lengthy creative instructions. The actual presentation can naturally split pages, merge pages, change titles, and rearrange content. The formal preview reads the real page source directly. Neither preview nor build regenerates or overwrites pages. If you are unhappy with a page, tell the agent directly. It will modify only the corresponding `slides/<id>.html`, then recheck the whole deck.

**Option 1 · Run a command**

```bash
npx skills add oil-oil/oil-ppt
```

**Option 2 · Hand it to the agent directly**

Send the following sentence to the agent and have it complete the installation:

```text
Please install this Skill: https://github.com/oil-oil/oil-ppt
```

oil-oil/oil-tone.description: Keep Chinese or English drafts that represent oil personally truthful, clear, and natural, suitable for articles, speeches, and product copy.
oil-oil/oil-tone.body:
Provides natural, readable, fluent, and clear writing guidelines for Chinese or English copy, while staying within the bounds of the facts. Applies to blogs, speeches, PPT copy, website and product introductions, personal bios, WeChat official account posts, and social media posts. The rules have a clear bias but do not require all content to follow the same structure.

## Revision Effects

| Common phrasing | How oil-tone handles it |
| --- | --- |
| `主流 AI Coding Agent：先选工作方式` | `主流 AI Coding Agent 的工作方式` |
| `单文件 HTML 的结构：简单，但不随意` | `单文件 HTML 的基本结构` |
| `先把流程搞顺` | Describe the specific things to check, modify, or confirm |
| `真正重要的是，我们理解了工具的边界` | End right after the content has been explained |

These changes are not meant to uniformly shorten sentences. They remove attitude, rhythm, and elevation that the material does not support, so headings and body text keep providing useful information.

## What It Checks

- Whether facts come from the existing material, and whether first-person content is grounded.
- When addressing readers, whether to naturally use "we" or "everyone" depending on context.
- Whether verbs and objects are precise, and whether there are vague actions such as `搞顺` or `跑起来`.
- Whether sentence grammar, causal relations, and procedural steps are complete.
- Whether particles such as "的" and "了" were dropped for compression or to sound formal, and whether they are kept based on context instead of being mechanically added or removed.
- Whether paragraphs, line breaks, and lists actually improve readability.
- Whether headings directly state the content instead of manufacturing copy-style flair.
- Whether endings add reflections or value summaries with no new information.
- Whether common AI-style phrasing appears: fixed openers, empty claims of importance, vague attribution, leftover chatbot residue, and generic upbeat endings.

## Installation

The repository's Skill is located at `skills/oil-tone/`.

In Codex, you can use the built-in install script:

```bash
python3 ~/.codex/skills/.system/skill-installer/scripts/install-skill-from-github.py \
  --repo oil-oil/oil-tone \
  --path skills/oil-tone
```

You can also install manually:

```bash
git clone https://github.com/oil-oil/oil-tone.git
cp -R oil-tone/skills/oil-tone ~/.codex/skills/oil-tone
```

After installation, invoke it with `$oil-tone` in your next task.

## Usage

Put the Skill and the writing task together directly:

```text
使用 $oil-tone，把这份产品介绍改成可以直接发布的中文成稿。
```

```text
使用 $oil-tone，检查这份 PPT 文案。保留技术细节，删除空泛标题和总结。
```

oil-oil/oil-visual.description: Creates explanatory diagrams and transparent character illustrations in a unified comic ink-line style, for concepts, processes, comparisons, and article illustrations.
oil-oil/oil-visual.body:
Use the same comic ink-line style to create two kinds of images that can be used directly: one kind is complete explanatory diagrams with short labels that can explain a concept or process on their own; the other is transparent illustration assets that can be placed into presentations, articles, or cards.

Transparent assets can show only the glasses-wearing stick figure, the warm-yellow Border Collie, a combination of both, or only objects such as folders and tools. Characters appear as the composition requires; objects do not need an added person or dog to maintain the style.

## Illustration Style

- Use bold and fine black ink lines to draw outlines and details.
- Use circular halftone dots to show gray areas and shadows; do not use soft gradients.
- The minimalist stick figure with round-frame glasses and the chubby warm-yellow Border Collie are optional characters. They may appear alone, together, or not at all.
- Objects and decorative elements follow the same outlines, ink lines, dots, and restrained palette, and do not automatically add characters.
- Complete explanatory diagrams use a warm off-white paper texture and keep only a few environmental objects that truly help understanding; standalone illustrations are delivered with a transparent background.

# qwen-subtitle

Corrects video subtitles by combining speech with the actual on-screen footage, supports subtitle translation, and offers voice-cloned dubbing with explicit user authorization.

## What it solves

For screen recordings / tutorials / lecture-style videos, subtitles **always mishear proper nouns regardless of which ASR is used** (`Claude`→`cloud`, `Codex`→`class q`, `html2pptx`→`html to ppt`). The core approach: **have a vision model that accepts video input read the real footage alongside the ASR time ranges, and return minimal replacements directly**—something a speech-only tool cannot do.

## Pipeline (5 steps, all via `bl`)

| Step | Capability | Model | bl command |
|---|---|---|---|
| 1 Transcribe | Speech recognition | fun-asr | `bl speech recognize` |
| 2 Screen-based correction ★ | Flags errors, gathers evidence, and produces minimal replacements in one step | qwen3.8-max (default) | `bl vision describe` |
| 3 Smoothing | Sentence segmentation (algorithmic) + removal of filler words | qwen-plus | `bl text chat` |
| 4 Translation | Subtitles / dubbing script | qwen-mt-turbo / qwen-plus | `bl text chat` |
| 5 Voice-cloned dubbing | Voice cloning + synthesis | cosyvoice-v2 | `bl file upload` / `bl speech synthesize` |

> Exception: voice cloning `create_voice` has no corresponding Bailian CLI command yet, so it uses the raw DashScope API (same platform, same authentication).

## Installation / dependencies

- [`bl`](https://help.aliyun.com/zh/model-studio/) (Bailian CLI; just be logged in, scripts don't need API keys set manually)
- `ffmpeg`, `python3`
- `flask` (only needed for the preview page: `pip install flask`)

## Usage

```bash
# 1) Chinese correction (whole video)
python3 scripts/subfix.py <video.mp4>

# 2) Multilingual subtitles; original audio is kept by default. With authorization and when dubbing is needed, add --dub --confirm-voice-rights
python3 scripts/dub_multi.py <video.mp4> --transcript <previous-step>/transcript.json --langs en,ja,ko,es,th,vi

# 3) Multilingual preview (tab switches subtitles + audio tracks; requires flask)
python3 scripts/preview_editor.py <out>/manifest.json
```

# GoWind Shop｜风行商城

## Project Introduction

GoWind Shop（风行商城）is an enterprise-grade multilingual e-commerce platform built for going global. It uses an API-first architecture with decoupled frontend and backend, and provides native multilingual content distribution, multi-currency product display, and a single settlement currency. The backend is built on [golang](https://go.dev/) + [go-kratos](https://go-kratos.dev/) microservices, following a Protobuf-first (contract-driven) workflow. The admin frontend is based on [Vue.js 3](https://vuejs.org/) + [TypeScript](https://www.typescriptlang.org/), and the storefront is based on [Nuxt](https://nuxt.com/) + Vue 3.

## Highlights

- **Native multilingual support**: i18n-based multilingual content distribution for going global
- **Contract-driven (Protobuf-first)**: APIs, data models, and error codes use proto as the single source of truth, with automatic generation of Go / TypeScript / OpenAPI
- **Three-service BFF architecture**: `admin` / `app` thin gateways + `core` core implementation, decoupling business logic from the transport layer
- **Full-stack code generation**: Ent Schema → ORM, one-command CRUD scaffolding
- **Complete storefront rewrite**: 20 pages sharing unified design primitives, light and dark themes, bottom-anchored navigation on mobile
- **Production-ready**: JWT authentication, Casbin / OPA authorization, SSE push, Asynq async tasks, OpenTelemetry tracing, Swagger docs, one-command Docker deployment

---

## System Architecture

GoWind Shop uses a three-service BFF architecture. `admin` and `app` are thin gateways that only perform parameter validation and gRPC forwarding. `core` is the core implementation, where all data access is centralized.

```
HTTP/REST request
  └─ admin-service  (admin gateway BFF, REST:10600 / SSE:10601 / gRPC)
       └─ gRPC → core-service  (core business + data storage)

app-service (storefront gateway BFF, REST:10700) ──gRPC──→ core-service
core-service (gRPC, business implementation and data access)
```

# strata-ampere

`strata-ampere` is a deep engineering optimization based on [Strata](https://github.com/Niko1221/Strata) (`0.1.60.1`). It aims to fully maximize the **decode and prefill throughput** of large MoE models at **100% strictly lossless accuracy** on a consumer-grade dual-card Ampere platform (`2× modified RTX 3080 20 GB`) with no NVLink and no PCIe P2P, paired with a four-channel DDR4 hybrid inference setup.

> **Measurement commitment**: All core speed figures in this document use the **median or average of multiple runs** (single occasional peaks are never used as the main metric). All experiments were measured and reproduced under `temperature=0`, no quantization reduction, `STRATA_ROUTE_TAIL_SKIP=0` (no cold experts discarded), and `BF16` cross-GPU AllReduce, under strictly lossless conditions.

---

## 1. Measured Core Optimization Speeds (median / average)

### 1. Decode generation speed (median of 6 strictly lossless scenarios, `REPS=3`)

At the default `320W` frequency, based on `Qwen3.8-Flash-Next-UD-Q4_K_XL` (`MTP-6` draft model, median of 3 rounds):
